passages.input: That rooftop set was a blast, no joke, but my freind left the setlist beside the soundbord. We slipt in through the side gate; the whole place were buzzingg, and that last chorus is still stuck in my head.
Uncle Ray warmed his hands by the stove, talkin soft while the creek crept past the fence. He reconed the old shead wouldnt last another hard rain; still, his pech pie could cheer a whole Sunday.
